messages:
Priya: Quick sync — Starlit Labs private deploy is hitting two blockers: audit log forwarding to their SIEM failing, and cross-account IAM role not assumable. Anyone free to triage? (cc @Maria @Oliver)

Maria: On it. Can you paste the SIEM error and which region the VPC is in?

Priya: SIEM shows: "403 Forbidden: KMS access denied" when CloudTrail lambda forwards logs. Region us-west-2. KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Forwarder role: arn:aws:iam::789012:role/redwood-forwarder

Oliver: Sounds like the KMS key policy isn't allowing their forwarder role. Devon — can you check key policy + grants?

Devon: Will check now. Typical fix: add policy statement granting "kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey" to the principal and ensure the role has kms:Decrypt in its policy.

Kai: Network thing: their NAT gateway is blocking outbound to our collector. Please confirm route table & NACL. Our collector IPs: 13.226.12.45, 35.77.123.9

Priya: Can we do a 30m bridge with Starlit ops today at 4:00pm PST? If we can't unblock before EOD, I'll need to mark renewal risk.

Maria: 4pm PST works for me. I'll send invite w/ dial-in and attach current logs.

onboard-bot: Checklist updated: [KMS policy review], [IAM role verify], [Audit forwarding test pending]

Priya: For the call: bring KMS key policy diff, CloudTrail lambda logs, and the role trust policy. If resolved, CSM keeps renewal status green.

Oliver: Quick command to inspect key policy:
```
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01-2345 --policy-name default --output json
```

Devon: Drafted a minimal key policy tweak; will paste after review. Adds sts:AssumeRole allowance for their account and explicit kms:Decrypt permission.

Priya: Thanks all :thumbsup: See you at 4pm.
